name: emergency-kill-switch-disarm
description: Disarm the emergency kill switch and return the system to normal monitoring state. Counterpart to emergency-kill-switch-arm. Shows status before and after, then verifies connectivity. Safe recovery path for a user who armed the kill switch.

steps.description: Run the typed workflow command 'echo '=== KILL SWITCH DISARM / RECOVER ===''.

colonyops_safety.rollback_hint: Review the step result and restore the prior state before continuing if the command changed system state.

steps.description: Check whether the kill switch high-alert flag is armed/disarmed. Shows armed time and trigger count. Arming is a state flag, not a monitor: nothing is watching and nothing auto-fires. Does NOT activate anything - just displays current status.
